About.title: About
About.subtitle: A little more about me and how I work.
About.p1: I build whole products — from the interface down to the database schema and the server that runs it. In practice that means a Next.js front end, a REST API in Go, schema and migrations in PostgreSQL, and the whole thing shipped as Docker containers through GitHub Actions.
About.p2: This site is one of those builds: three services — the public site, an admin CMS and the Go API — running behind Caddy on a single VPS, redeployed on every push. I care about the details a visitor never notices but always feels: fast loads, predictable behaviour, and code the next person — usually future me — can follow.
